title: Novel pyridine-heterocycle hybrids: synthesis via Hantzsch and Biginelli reactions, docking simulations, and anticancer activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7389-7409
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00243A, Paper

Hadeer M. Diab, Mostafa E. Salem, Ahmed H. M. Elwahy, Mohamed A. Ragheb, Mahmoud A. Noamaan, Faisal K. Algethami, Ismail A. Abdelhamid, Huda Kamel Mahmoud
Novel pyridine–heterocycle hybrids were synthesized via Hantzsch and Biginelli reactions. Anticancer activity was evaluated experimentally and supported by docking studies, providing insight into structure–activity relationships.
